intro: Orange Chicken is the primary flagship entrée at Panda Express. First developed by Executive Chef Andy Kao in 1987, this dish features crispy wok-tossed dark-meat chicken pieces coated in a sweet and tangy chili glaze with orange zest, garlic, and ginger notes. It represents Panda Express's highest-volume menu item nationwide.

isHealthy.content: While Orange Chicken provides a substantial {{protein:orange-chicken}} grams of poultry protein, it is calorie-dense and higher in carbohydrates and sugars compared to wok-steamed options. Because the chicken pieces are battered and deep-fried before being coated in a sweetened glaze, a single serving carries {{cal:orange-chicken}} calories and {{fat:orange-chicken}}g of total fat. It works best as a flavorful indulgence or when paired with nutrient-dense sides like Super Greens to keep the total meal macros balanced.
